data-icon.note: A name in contract/sections.json icons (content or chrome).

zeroState: Not drawn for an unknown or undrawable name (logged).

notes.text: The svg is the element; WordPress's span.x-icon wrapper goes. Colour is currentColor only.

The names are the union of both platforms' glyphs, listed in contract/sections.json under icons and split into content names an editor may choose and chrome names only the system draws (SC-007). Both platforms draw every name; the artwork stays each platform's own. For a social name (bluesky, facebook, github, instagram, linkedin, pinterest, reddit, tiktok, whatsapp, x, youtube), a platform that ships no mark of its own may draw the shared globe glyph; the markup is identical either way, data-icon keeps the social name, and the link's accessible name carries the platform (SC-008). The gate refuses an icon name in markup or fields that the list lacks.

owes: Put class, data-icon, data-size and the naming on the svg itself.
Draw chevron-right, external-link, moon and sun, which it has no glyph for today (SC-007).
